description: Données Ouvertes sur les Datacenters - Bâtiments au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l'Éfficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique. Ces données fournissent des informations sur les bâtiments des datacenters au Togo, en précisant leur localisation, leur capacité d'hébergement, ainsi que les infrastructures disponibles (équipements de stockage, refroidissement, sécurité, etc.). Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l'Éfficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support digital infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
